title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2027 – Undergraduate Students
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
eligibility_summary: High school seniors or recent graduates from countries with diplomatic relations with Japan. Age typically 17–25. Must indicate intended major. Requirements vary by Japanese diplomatic mission.
funding_details: Round-trip airfare, full tuition, monthly stipend (¥117,000 for undergraduate/college of technology/specialized training college students; ¥143,000–145,000 for teacher training/specialized training in Japanese language), with additional stipend for designated areas. Includes one-year intensive Japanese language training if needed.
duration: 5 years (April 2027 – March 2032); 6 years for medicine/dentistry/veterinary medicine/pharmacy

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2027 – Research Students
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
eligibility_summary: Graduate or postgraduate students under 35 years old with a bachelor's degree or equivalent (16 years of schooling). Open to all majors. Must explain intended field of study and benefit to Japan-home country relations.
funding_details: Round-trip airfare, full tuition, monthly stipend (¥144,000 for master's/professional degree; ¥145,000 for doctoral; ¥143,000 for non-degree research students), with additional stipend for designated areas. Includes six-month preparatory Japanese language training if required.
duration: 2 years or length of degree program (April 2027 – March 2028, extendable)

title: Japanese Government (MEXT) Scholarship 2026 – Japanese Studies Students
provider: Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT), Japan
eligibility_summary: Undergraduate students at a non-Japanese university majoring in Japanese language or Japanese culture. Must have studied Japanese for at least one year. Must be able to travel to Embassy of Japan in Washington, D.C. for screening.
funding_details: Round-trip airfare, full tuition, monthly stipend (¥117,000), with additional stipend for designated areas.

title: JASSO Monbukagakusho Honors Scholarship for Privately-Financed International Students
degree_levels: Undergraduate, Master's, Doctoral, Research, Junior College, College of Technology, Specialized Training College, Japanese Language Institution
application_deadline: Varies by university (typically April or October for spring/autumn terms)
eligibility_summary: Privately financed international students enrolled or planning to enroll in eligible Japanese institutions. Must have excellent academic achievement (GPA ≥ 2.30), Japanese (JLPT N2/EJU) or English (CEFR B2) proficiency, and financial need (monthly remittance < ¥90,000).
funding_details: ¥48,000 per month for university/graduate school/junior college/college of technology/specialized training college students; ¥30,000 per month for Japanese language institution students. Duration: 1 year (April–March) or 6 months (October–March).

title: JASSO Student Exchange Support Program (Scholarship for Study in Japan under Agreement)
degree_levels: Undergraduate, Master's, Doctoral, Junior College, College of Technology, Specialized Training College
application_deadline: Varies by Japanese host university under exchange agreement
eligibility_summary: International students accepted by a Japanese institution under a student exchange agreement. Must return to home institution after exchange. Must not receive >¥80,000/month from other scholarships. Countries with diplomatic relations with Japan (Taiwan and Palestine also eligible).
funding_details: ¥80,000 per month. Covers short-term study from 8 days to 1 year.

title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Standard Program (FY2027, 1st Round)
provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
application_deadline: August 28, 2026 (5:00 PM JST, via host institution)
application_opening: Approximately June 2026 (system opens ~2 months before deadline)
eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas. Must have a Japanese host researcher/institution. Application submitted by host institution through JSPS Electronic Application System.
funding_details: Monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, research allowance, and insurance coverage. Exact amounts specified in FY2027 guidelines.
duration: April 1, 2027 – September 30, 2027 (commencement date flexible within period)

title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Standard Program (FY2027, 2nd Round)
provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
application_deadline: April 23, 2027 (5:00 PM JST, via host institution)
eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas with a Japanese host researcher/institution. Application submitted by host institution.
funding_details: Monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, research allowance, and insurance coverage.
duration: September 1, 2027 – November 30, 2027 (commencement date flexible within period)

title: JSPS Postdoctoral Fellowships for Research in Japan – Short-term PE (FY2027, 1st Round)
provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
application_deadline: September 25, 2026 (5:00 PM JST, via host institution)
eligibility_summary: Postdoctoral researchers from overseas with a Japanese host researcher/institution. Short-term program for collaborative research.
funding_details: Monthly stipend, round-trip airfare, research allowance, and insurance coverage.

title: JSPS Invitational Fellowships for Research in Japan – FY2027 (1st Round, Long-term & Short-term)
provider: Japan Society for the Promotion of Science (JSPS)
application_deadline: August 28, 2026 (5:00 PM JST, via host institution)
eligibility_summary: Overseas researchers invited by a Japanese host institution. Long-term and short-term programs available. Application submitted by host institution via JSPS Electronic Application System.
funding_details: Stipend, round-trip airfare, and research-related expenses. Details in FY2027 guidelines.
duration: Long-term: April 1, 2027 – March 31, 2028; Short-term: flexible within FY2027

title: Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Scholarship 2027 (Overseas Candidates)
eligibility_summary: International students residing outside Japan who plan to enroll at a Japanese university or graduate school in April or September/October 2027. Must have JLPT N3 or above at time of application. Must have applied to a Japanese institution and submit admission application copy. Research students not eligible.
funding_details: ¥100,000 per month (undergraduate); ¥140,000 per month (master's and doctoral). Travel subsidy up to ¥250,000 toward airfare and related costs (receipt-based). Payment begins April 2027 (April enrollment) or September/October 2027 (fall enrollment).
